in_sanskrit.name: अक्षत्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Akshat is a Sanskrit word that means 'unbroken, intact, whole, or inviolable.' It is a term that represents the idea of something that is undamaged and untouched, and is often used to signify the divine grace and abundance of the universe in Hindu mythology and rituals.

in_marathi.name: Akshat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akshat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Akshat is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘akshata’, which means ‘invincible’, ‘undefeatable’, or ‘unconquerable’. In Hindu mythology, Akshat is associated with Lord Vishnu and represents divine grace and protection. The name is believed to bestow courage, strength, and wisdom upon the bearer.
